youtube.baslik: Does the middle ear have its own resonant frequency? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the middle ear, stiffness opposes sound most at low frequencies and mass most at high frequencies; the frequency where they balance is the resonant frequency. In healthy adults, it is usually between 800 and 1200 Hz; it rises in otosclerosis and drops with ossicular chain discontinuity.

cumleler: Does the middle ear have its own resonant frequency?
Stiffness opposes sound most at low frequencies.
Mass opposes it more as frequency rises.
Where the two balance is the resonant frequency.
In healthy adults, it is usually eight hundred to twelve hundred hertz.
It rises in otosclerosis and drops with ossicular discontinuity.
